title: SimInter: Evidence-Grounded User Simulation with Interview-Based Profile Enrichment for Conversational Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.18308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational Recommender Systems (CRSs) require reliable user simulators for cost-effective evaluation. LLM-based simulators have made realistic simulation possible but typically condition on profiles derived from explicit ratings, demographics, and static sources capturing surface preferences while omitting implicit behavioral characteristics such as decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, and domain expertise. We propose SimInter, a pipeline that elicits these attributes via synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, grounded in the user's statistical profile and historical conversational evidence. Before profile enrichment, an audit agent explicitly flags potential fabrication and stereotyping at the turn level. We instantiate and evaluate SimInter on movie recommendation. We simulate 300 ReDial users and, on a matched subset of 100 users, compare SimInter with a statistics-only baseline: SimInter significantly increase

translated_title: SimInter：面向对话式推荐系统的基于证据的用户模拟与访谈式画像增强方法
translated_abstract: 会话式推荐系统（CRS）需要可靠的用户模拟器来实现低成本、高效率的评估。基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟器使逼真的模拟成为可能，但它们通常依赖于从显式评分、人口统计信息和静态数据源中提取的用户画像，这类画像只能捕捉表层偏好，而忽略了决策风格、属性级偏好和领域专业知识等隐式行为特征。我们提出了SimInter，这是一个通过两个LLM智能体之间的合成访谈来引出上述隐式属性的流水线，其内容扎根于用户的统计画像和历史对话证据。在画像增强之前，一个审计智能体会在对话轮次级别明确标记潜在的捏造和刻板印象问题。我们在电影推荐场景中对SimInter进行了实例化和评估。我们模拟了300个ReDial用户，并在100个用户的匹配子集上，将SimInter与仅使用统计信息的基线进行比较：SimInter显著提升了（原文此处截断）。
tldr: SimInter通过两个LLM智能体之间的合成访谈来丰富用户的隐式行为特征（如决策风格、属性级偏好和领域专长），并借助审计智能体在轮次级别标记捏造与刻板印象，从而为对话式推荐系统提供基于证据、更可靠的用户模拟器。
en_tdlr: SimInter enriches user profiles with implicit behavioral attributes (decision-making style, aspect-level preferences, domain expertise) through synthetic interviews between two LLM agents, audited turn-by-turn against fabrication and stereotyping, yielding evidence-grounded and more reliable user simulators for evaluating conversational recommender systems.
